channel.title: TCEA Vibe-Coded Solutions — Updates
channel.description: New and updated HTML tools, dashboards, prompt libraries, and classroom resources from TCEA.

item.title: 🕵️ Black Freedom Holidays Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A standards correlation guide mapping the twelve July 5 & Black Freedom Holidays breakouts by grade band to Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills, Common Core literacy standards, and the CLEAR thinking process.

item.title: 🕵️ July 5 & Black Freedom Holidays Breakouts
item.description: Twelve self-contained digital breakouts across three grade bands (3-5, 6-8, 9-12) exploring the freedom days the calendar often overlooks — Frederick Douglass s July 5 address, Juneteenth, Pinkster, Watch Night, and more. Students open clues, weigh evidence, and crack four locks each. No logins, no data collected.

item.title: 🕵️ Fourth of July Digital Breakouts
item.description: Twelve self-contained U.S. history escape activities across three grade bands (3-5, 6-8, 9-12). Students open clues, weigh evidence, and crack four locks each — building history knowledge and critical-thinking habits. No logins, no data collected.

item.title: 🕵️ Fourth of July Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A standards correlation guide mapping the twelve Fourth of July breakouts by grade band to Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills, Common Core literacy standards, and the CLEAR thinking process.

item.title: 📊 Data Display Patterns
item.description: A TCEA field guide to choosing the right chart and data-display pattern for dashboards and reports.

item.title: 📊 Assessment System RFP Scoring Tool
item.description: A weighted rubric for comparing district assessment systems, with non-negotiable gate checks and a side-by-side vendor comparison you can export to CSV.

item.title: 🕵️ Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A multilingual correlation guide mapping the Critical Thinking Breakouts to standards and thinking skills.

item.title: 🕵️ Critical Thinking Breakouts
item.description: Grade-band breakout activities (3-5, 6-8, 9-12) across ELA, science, and social studies that teach evidence-based reasoning, available in seven languages.

item.title: 🕵️ Breakouts Answer Key
item.description: The facilitator answer key and recording sheet for running the Critical Thinking Breakouts activities.

item.title: 🕵️ The CLEAR Crew — Detective Thinking Game
item.description: Crack the case one clue at a time with the CLEAR thinking process — a critical-thinking checklist for young detectives.

item.title: 📊 School District App Intake Form
item.description: A teacher and staff app intake form for submitting apps for district review, with an optional Google Sheets backend for collecting requests.

item.title: 🤖 LibVibes Prompt Library
item.description: Nineteen library-focused vibe-coding starter prompts, each with a VIBES game plan and its own linkable page, all nineteen built and playable.

item.title: ⭐ Codex Project Organizer
item.description: A beginner-friendly brief builder that turns a project idea into a structured Markdown prompt for AI-assisted coding, with a modular version for defining inputs, outputs, and tests.

item.title: ⭐ TCEA Tools Menu
item.description: The launch menu for classroom utilities including spinners, dice, word search, drawing, puzzles, and fortune tools.

item.title: 🧰 Classroom Shape Spinner
item.description: A shape spinner for math, discussion, selection, and quick classroom activities.

item.title: 🎲 Vibe Coding Projects for Librarians

item.title: ⭐ Vibe-Coding for Librarians
item.description: A companion website with librarian-focused tools, use cases, prompts, and downloadable vibe-coding resources.
